text:
maria.security: Heads-up — privacy erasure job for requester user_8345 failed during crypto step. Saw this in the cleanup worker logs: `ERROR: decryption failed: KeyDisabled (kms://projects/redwood/keys/keystore-prod)`

liam.ops: ack. Is this the rotated key we ran last night? :eyes:

maria.security: yes, rotation completed at 2026-03-20T23:12Z. Most deletes passed but ~120 jobs errored out and are stuck in failed queue.

sasha.eng: can you paste the exact worker stack?

maria.security: sure — snippet:```
2026-03-21T00:05:12Z worker-3 cleanup_job: starting erasure for embedding-id e-xx
2026-03-21T00:05:12Z worker-3 kms: decrypt failed: KeyDisabled
2026-03-21T00:05:12Z worker-3 cleanup_job: marking FAILED, will not retry without manual requeue
```

josh.privacy: tagging legal for retention implications — if these are DSAR erasures, we need to ensure evidence of attempted deletion and a fallback timeline. @legal-bot please flag if we need retention-exception paperwork. :triangular_flag_on_post:

legal-bot: Noted. If these are user-initiated DSAR erasures, generate an exception ticket and include attempt logs + key rotation audit. Keep user informed within 30 days.

liam.ops: quick check — the rotation was scheduled and we set old key to Disabled state before rewrapping snapshots. That might be the issue: queued deleted artifacts were encrypted with old key and we disabled it early.

sasha.eng: ugh. We should have used `ScheduleKeyDeactivation` window. What state is the old key in now?

keystore-bot: Key `keystore-prod-v1` status = Disabled; last_rotate = 2026-03-20T23:12Z; previous state = Enabled; rotation_request = 2026-03-20T22:50Z.

maria.security: action items I propose: 1) temporarily re-enable the old key to allow decryption and finish erasures for DSARs; 2) requeue failed jobs; 3) produce audit entries showing re-enable action and approvals; 4) follow-up to update rotation playbook to avoid disabling until backlog drained.

liam.ops: +1 to that plan. Re-enabling requires a breakglass approval per keystore policy. Who can sign?

sasha.eng: I can do an ops-led breakglass if legal concurs. I'll wait for @josh.privacy or legal-bot to confirm.

josh.privacy: legal-bot, please confirm it's OK to re-enable old key temporarily for DSAR fulfillment only. We will capture all logs and lock actions.

legal-bot: Confirmed conditional approval. Requirements: (a) restrict re-enable to a ten-minute window via IAM constraint, (b) require two approvers (sasha.eng + maria.security), (c) record audit log and attach to DSAR case file.

maria.security: I'll approve. sasha, you take the second approver and do the re-enable window.

sasha.eng: starting now — executing: `gcloud kms keys versions enable keystore-prod-v1 --project=redwood` (will wrap this in ephemeral IAM session). Will post start/end audit.

liam.ops: hold off requeue until keystore-bot confirms decrypt success on a sample object.

keystore-bot: sample decrypt test for e-xx: SUCCESS at 2026-03-21T00:18:09Z (used keystore-prod-v1). Audit id = audit-20260321-001.

maria.security: requeue command to cleanup worker: `./jobs/requeue_failed.sh --queue=erasure-failures --filter=encrypted_with:keystore-prod-v1`

sasha.eng: requeue done. Jobs processing now. I'll tail the worker logs for DSAR prefixes.

maria.security: psuedo-checklist: [x] approval obtained, [x] re-enable window, [x] sample decrypt OK, [x] requeue kicked, [ ] confirm all DSARs completed, [ ] attach audit to cases, [ ] update rotation playbook.

liam.ops: so how many DSARs affected? we said ~120 jobs — how many are actual user erasure vs background housekeeping?

maria.security: filtered: 47 user DSAR erasures, 73 internal orphan snapshot scrubs. We'll prioritize the 47 first and mark completed in case system.

josh.privacy: once the 47 are done, create a short DSAR status update note to send to the requesters. Legal will review wording.

keystore-bot: All requeued DSAR jobs processed: 47 succeeded, 73 succeeded (orphan scrubs). Last job finished 2026-03-21T00:33:27Z. Audit bundle: s3://redwood-audit/2026-03-21/keystore-rotation-reenable-audit-3300001234.zip

maria.security: attaching audit to DSAR case and closing the incident. Follow-up: update rotation playbook to include "wait-for-empty-backlog" check and a pre-rotation hook to signal DSAR agent. I'll open a PR.

sasha.eng: PR for playbook update coming in `infra/security` branch. Will add a gating job: `make ensure-no-pending-erasures` before `kms rotate`.

josh.privacy: thanks team. Two follow-ups: 1) remediation note for compliance (I'll draft), 2) add monitoring alert for KMS-disabled-decrypt-errors spiking > 5/min.

liam.ops: I'll add the alert to pager-policy with severity P2.

maria.security: thanks everyone. Closing thread once PR merged and the DSAR notes are filed. :white_check_mark:

sasha.eng: merged playbook PR at 2026-03-21T02:10Z. Closing loop. :lock:
